evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen to 13.9 ppm, followed by low oxygen throughout ramp and growth.
Initial growth temperature overshoot to 760.6 °C accompanied by heater power reduction to 40%; subsequent readings settle toward the 750 °C setpoint.
Temperature is 750.0 °C at the 750.0 °C setpoint, with heater power 45.3%.
Argon 100.2 sccm matches the 100 sccm setpoint; pressure is stable at 759.9 Torr, oxygen 5.3 ppm, and controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth sample characterization is needed to determine whether the target material grew.
